thread:
sam: Heads-up team: product is scheduling a deprecation for the v1 streaming frame and alias fallback. We need a short migration bridge doc, a codemod, banner copy, link redirects, and CI smoke jobs. Owner volunteers?
elaine: I can do the migration doc and Ruby/Go snippets. Will try to keep examples <15 lines each.
jon: I'll take JS/Python snippets and coordinate the SDK warning hooks. We should emit a clear runtime warning linking to the doc.
priya: I'll own the codemod that mass-upgrades internal examples and samples. Plan: a small jscodeshift + a grep/replace fallback script at scripts/codemod/stream_v1_to_v2.js.
sam: Good. Requirements: 1) in-page deprecation banner with target removal date, 2) redirect table for old embed alias pages, 3) codemod + quick manual checklist, 4) GH Actions smoke job that runs snippets against canary, 5) small changelog blurb for SDKs.
elaine: Draft banner copy idea: "Notice: Legacy v1 streaming behavior will be retired on 2026-06-30. See migration guide for a quick example and automated codemod." Keep it short.
jon: Snippet note: JS streaming will flip to the new shape; here's the tiny example I'll include in the doc:
```
// JS streaming (v2 shape)
const s = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-2', stream_format: 'json-chunks' });
for await (const ev of s) { process.stdout.write(ev.delta || ''); }
```
elaine: Ruby example (compact):
```
# Ruby v2 streaming
stream = client.responses.stream(model: 'rwd-stream-2', stream_format: 'json-chunks')
stream.each { |chunk| STDOUT.write(chunk['delta'] || '') }
```
priya: Codemod plan: 1) find calls referencing `stream: true` or old streaming callbacks, 2) replace with `stream_format: 'json-chunks'`, 3) add deprecation link comment. Will add a dry-run mode.
sam: Smoke job: GH Action `docs-smoke/streaming_migration.yml` that checks out docs, runs codemod in dry-run, executes snippets (node, python, ruby) against CANARY endpoint and fails on any 4xx. Keep job small and opt-in for canary windows.
jon: SDKs: add a runtime logger.warn when callers pass legacy streaming flags. Message should be: "v1 streaming is deprecated; see <DEPRECATION_LINK>". Include a one-line changelog entry in releases.
elaine: Docs checklist for PRs: update example files, add banner HTML/snippet, add redirect rules (netlify/_redirects style), include codemod link, add smoke GH Action reference, add review tag `@jon @priya`.
priya: Timeline proposal: draft doc + codemod Tue, snippets Wed, PRs open Thu, smoke CI green by next Mon, staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks. Is that feasible?
sam: Sounds good. I'll schedule rollout with infra: canary 10% this Friday, bump 50% after green smoke. Also attach a short alias replacement mini-table in the doc with common replacements and an estimated cost delta column.
docs-bot: Created PR checklist template: `deprecations/migration_bridge_template.md` and added it to the repo. :white_check_mark:
sam: Great. Tag me in your PRs. If anyone needs sample fixture tokens or a canary URL, DM and I'll provision. Closing here until drafts land.
